phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, around 3 minutes, with heavy technology investment and moderate production. Opponent shows a ground posture with possible Reaper pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or if you detect a significant tech switch.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on defensive structures and tech, keep production steady, expand cautiously.
phase_policies.target: Stabilize defense while developing economy and technology. Maintain defensive posture to deter early aggression.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Stabilization
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to expansions or tech that leaves you vulnerable to early pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, around 5-6 minutes, with heavy production and tech. Opponent shows a ground posture with Marines and Reapers.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have scouted the opponent's tech path or if they attempt a timing attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize production and tech upgrades, expand to support economy, keep defense solid.
phase_policies.target: Maintain defensive posture while increasing production and tech. Continue to expand to support growing army.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Expansion and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-extend with expansions or tech that leaves you vulnerable to early pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, around 9 minutes, with a heavy ground army and heavy tech. Opponent has a strong ground army with Siege Tanks and Medivacs.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a clear army advantage or if the opponent switches to a more air-heavy composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Build up ground forces, add production, consider Dark Templars for Siege Tanks, stay defensive.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and increase production. Maintain defensive posture while preparing for potential engagement.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not engage head-on into a well-positioned Siege Tank line without proper support or a plan to break it.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, around 10-12 minutes, with a heavy ground army and some air support. Opponent has a heavy ground army with Marines.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a clear army advantage or if the opponent switches to a more air-heavy composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance ground and air production, keep defense strong, adapt to opponent's composition.
phase_policies.target: Continue to strengthen ground army while adding air support to deal with potential threats. Maintain defensive posture.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground/Air Hybrid
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-commit to air units before confirming opponent's intentions, leaving you exposed to early aggression.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
